videos.title: Wispr Flow's Notetaker is Game-Changing
videos.description:
Have you ever zoned out on a Zoom call, then realised you’ve missed the last two minutes?

I’ve been trying Wispr Flow’s Notetaker, which records and transcribes meetings in real time. You can ask it what you missed, search previous meetings for specific decisions, and use the transcripts with tools like ChatGPT and Claude to draft follow-up emails or messages.

Very useful if, like me, you spend a lot of time in meetings, and even more time trying to remember what actually happened in them. 

It’s currently available on Mac and Windows, and the Notetaker is free to use.

Copy this link for one month of Wispr Flow Pro for free: https://ref.wisprflow.ai/ali_shorts_notetaker
